children: LiqTech International Inc. (LIQT) filed a Form 8K - Director, Officer or Compensation Filing - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on October 06, 2026.

On September 30, 2026, the board of directors of the Company appointed Michael Schrøder as Interim Chief Financial Officer of the Company, effective November 1, 2026. Mr. Schrøder, age 51, is currently the Group CFO of Link Logistics A/S, an international logistics company, specializing in express and parcel shipments, supported by freight forwarding, warehousing and customized solutions, based in Brøndby, Denmark, where he has been since November 2025. Prior to Link, Mr. Schrøder was the Group CFO/Group CEO (Interim) at LEMAN A/S, a global logistics and transport company based in Greve, Denmark, from April 2024 to September 2025. From 2022 to April 2024, Mr. Schrøder was the Group CFO at Deas A/S, a Danish property management and advisory company. Prior to his time at Deas, Mr. Schrøder was the CFO/Finance Director at Fitness World Group, a Danish fitness center chain, from 2020 to 2022. Mr. Schrøder holds a Master of Science in Economics, Finance and Accounting from the University of Copenhagen and a Master of Finance, Behavioural Finance from the University of Glasgow.

On September 30, 2026, the Company (through its wholly owned Danish subsidiary) and Mr. Schrøder (through his consulting company, LMMM Holding ApS) entered into an Interim Chief Financial Officer Consultancy Agreement (the "Agreement"), effective November 1, 2026 (or earlier if mutually agreed by the parties). The Agreement provides that LMMM Holding ApS will receive a fixed fee of DK 200,000 (US$30,105 as of the date of this report) per month. The Agreement has a term until March 31, 2027, which may be extended upon mutual agreement of the parties.

The foregoing descriptions of the Agreement is not complete and is in summary form only and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the full text of the Agreement, which is filed as Exhibit 10.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K.

Mr. Schrøder does not have any family relationships with any of the Company's other officers or directors and he has no direct or indirect material interest in any transaction required to be disclosed pursuant to Item 404(a) of Regulation S-K.
